text.description_html:
First Impressions DS-SS-4.5 Modern Long Stainless Steel Door Stop

Constructed of solid stainless steel this 4-1/2" long modern door stop screws onto the baseboard casement, door bottom or wall anchor, to protect not just the wall and door, but your door knob or lever as well.

These long door stops are suited for special applications. Typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

For use in residential and commercial applications. Available in your choice of soft Satin Stainless Steel or bright Polished Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications of First Impressions DS-SS-4.5 Long Door Stop

  • Total Length: 4-1/2"
  • Diameter: 1/2"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • White Rubber Bumper Tip

*Sold Individually



**Item Discontinued. See available Door Stops
